{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not completed revenue)
data_completed = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Stratify by customer segment and compute conversion rate and average revenue within each segment
stratified = data_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).agg(
    count=('converted', 'size'),
    converted_mean=('converted', 'mean'),
    revenue_mean=('revenue_clean', 'mean')
).round(4)

# Display stratified results
print('Stratified conversion and revenue by channel and segment:\n', stratified)

# Compute the difference in conversion rate within each segment
# First, pivot to get conversion rate per segment per channel
pivot = stratified.pivot_table(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='converted_mean')

# Compute difference (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']

print('\nDifference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:\n', diff)

# Compute the average revenue difference by segment
diff_revenue = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']
print('\nDifference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:\n', diff_revenue)"}
